title: MetaRDK
description: MetaRDK is an intracranial EEG (SEEG) dataset collected from patients with pharmacologically intractable epilepsy performing a perceptual decision-making task involving a random dot motion discrimination and subsequent confidence rating. The dataset provides high-gamma power (70-150Hz) activity segmented per trial, along with behavioral data such as response times, confidence judgments, and changes of mind, aimed at elucidating the neural correlates of decision-making and metacognition, particularly in the pre-supplementary motor area and insula.
methods_description: Data were recorded intracranially at the bedside using a Micromed recording system, with electrode implantation determined by clinical need. Patients performed a random dot motion discrimination task with an adaptive staircase to titrate difficulty at 70% accuracy, followed by confidence ratings on a 0-100 scale. High-gamma activity (five non-overlapping bands between 70-150Hz) was extracted and segmented from trial onset to offset, sampled at 512Hz. Trials and channels with high epilepsy-related artifacts were excluded.
